decision: the overseer, the operator's proxy, a2-bounded-learning-authorized-20261023, IK/FK AND CALIBRATION: a focused saved-pose and zero-rotation diagnosis within the unspent 768.30 seconds of the existing question
meaning: A DIAGNOSIS, NOT A CALIBRATION AND NOT A STATIONARITY VERDICT. Per case it reports which rule ended the floor fit's polish, the turn as rotmat_log and as a form without its dead zone read it, the projected gradient with each, and how far continuations on the dead-zone-free potential move the angles and the residuals against the calibration run's lines, beside a control continuation on the module's own potential; true non-convergence, the dead zone's effect and numerical rounding are reported apart by the declared rule (rules). The arm fit module's stationarity check is unchanged and is not evaluated here.

rules.moves: a run moves when it changes some part's residual by more than 0.01 of that part's line in the calibration run's record
rules.verdict: true_non_convergence: R6, the control on the module's own potential (rotmat_log, ftol 0, gtol 1e-10, from R1's angles), moves; dead_zone_effect: R6 does not move and R3, R4 or R5 (the precise turn) moves; numerical_rounding: no run (R3 to R6) moves and one reaches stationarity (R6, R3 or R4 ends on gtol with its result kept, R5's polish ends on gtol with its result kept, or R5's flow settles; listed in stationary_reached_by); unresolved: R3 to R6 all ran, none moves and none reaches stationarity; incomplete: R6 does not move, no precise run with readings moves, and R3, R4 or R5 has no readings (not started, a failed R5 fit, or an R3 or R4 whose minimize raised); not_run: R6 has no readings (not started, or its minimize raised), or the case stopped before R2; a run whose minimize raised never counts as "does not move"
rules.control_made_no_step: R6's end point is R1's angles exactly (a line search that failed at once, a raise, or a result not kept): a dead_zone_effect label then rests on the precise runs alone
rules.why_the_control: R3, R4 and R5 all remove the dead zone, whose scale (about 1.5e-8 rad) is 0.41 and 0.34 of the left and right wrist rotation lines (about 0.1 of the other parts'), so a residual change they make can come from the dead zone alone; R6 keeps it, so a residual change R6 makes cannot
rules.why_the_share: each line is the largest floor residual of its part, so residual changes under 1% of every line leave every line within 1% of itself: the fit's stopping point did not set the lines
rules.correction_reads_stationary: R1's flow settled, or R4 (the precise turn, ftol 0, gtol 1e-10) ends on gtol with its precise projected gradient at or under 1e-10 rad
rules.correction_is_a_change_of_potential: the 1e-10 line is unchanged, but the proposed correction measures it on the precise-turn potential after a continuation that moves the fit's angles: a change of potential, not of threshold (design section 5); nothing here builds it
rules.control_reads_stationary: R1's flow settled, or R6 (the module's own potential, ftol 0, gtol 1e-10) ends on gtol with its rotmat_log projected gradient at or under 1e-10 rad: a change of the stopping rule only; at an end point in the dead zone (control_end_in_dead_zone) its turn term reads 0
rules.solver_potential: R1's solver readings are on the module's potential (rotmat_log); R5's on the precise potential (precise_log), since R5 runs with the turn replaced
rules.dead_zone: rotmat_log returns a zero turn when (trace - 1) / 2 rounds to 1 or above: the trace of a turn by theta is 3 - theta^2 + theta^4 / 12, float64 numbers near 3 lie 4.4e-16 apart, so true turns below about 1.5e-8 rad can read exactly 0; above that edge the returned turn is the skew part scaled by angle / sin(angle), close to the true turn
rules.precise_log: angle atan2(|v| / 2, (trace - 1) / 2), v the skew part, axis v / |v|
rules.deadline: counted from this program's first line; the interpreter's startup before it is not counted, so the runner's measured wall time is the time charged to the question
